title: An Eastern Promise
subtitle: Words weighed heavier than his own life.

items.speaker: Night Watch
items.text: The night is dry. Beware of fires!
The night watch's gong reverberates into the night. Only then does Chéng Héguāng jump from the tree, studying the alley before him intently.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: This is where that strange parade was last seen. Hm?

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: Hey, you! What are you doing out here at this hour?

items.speaker: Du Liu
items.text: Wǔ! It's her.
Chéng Héguāng turns toward the source of the sound. Yáng Wǔ and Dù Liù have cornered a wounded woman.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Yáng Wǔ, Dù Liù, what's going on?
Seeing him, the two exchange an awkward glance.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Well now, fate always finds a way to put enemies in your path, eh?

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: Chief! We were on patrol duty. We ran into the Daoist. She was the one with the School of Mei.
Chéng Héguāng narrows his eyes as he spots the woman. His right hand falling instinctively to his blade.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: What are you doing here?

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Long story.
He ignores her response, instead, sweeping his eyes over the woman's bloodstained robes.

items.speaker: Du Liu
items.text: Chief?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Return to your patrol. I will take her to the Yamen later.

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: But Chief, the commander ordered us to—
Dù Liù gives his partner a prod with his elbow and takes over the conversation.

items.speaker: Du Liu
items.text: Let's go, Wǔ. I'm sure the chief has his own score to settle with her.

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: His own score ... Aah.
Yáng Wǔ at last realizes what's going on and nods knowingly.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Just a few questions. Is that alright?

items.speaker: Du Liu
items.text: Of course. Take your time, Chief. We were never here.
The two cup their fists in a salute and hurry away.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Much appreciated. Seems you and I just can't seem to avoid each other.
Paper Heron leans against the wall. She coughs, and a small trickle of blood escapes her lips.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Would you be willing to hear what I have to say? I need a favor. It's about the safety of this city.
The believers hold torches, gathering in the square beside the pond.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: As difficult as it is to believe, we must face the truth: Paper Heron has turned against us.

items.speaker: School of Mei Believer II
items.text: But wasn't she your guide to longevity? Why would she turn her back on us after all her efforts?

items.speaker: School of Mei Believer III
items.text: She's been kind to us, and we have paid her our respect. How did it come to this?

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Her long life has hardened her heart to us.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: But when we succeed and join her in longevity, her status and authority will be challenged.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: I can't believe this.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: The moment she learned of our goal, she chose to become an obstacle. Now that she has taken the Longevity Sword, her position is clear.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Remember, the Qi from that sword is instrumental to our success. Without it, we will not survive.
The Yao below the platform grow restless. Emotions flash across their faces—surprise, sorrow, and anger.

items.speaker: Hedgehog
items.text: I knew it. At first, I thought she cared when she gave us those amulets, but when she challenged Master Rén, I realized it was all a farce.

items.speaker: Badger
items.text: All that talk about the "right path" and serving the Way, as if we had the time to do any of that!

items.speaker: Badger
items.text: We sacrificed so much for longevity. We can't fail now!

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Without the sword, the Quelling Array will weaken. I can still subdue the beast with elixirs, but it will leave me without the strength to shield you from harm.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: But we still have a chance. I wounded her when she wrestled the sword from me. We must take it back before she recovers.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: So I bid you: go forth and find her. Secure the sword at any cost!

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: But before you risk your lives this night, hear these words: The path before us is set. We will slay Lǎnzhū and draw upon its power to ascend. If you do not share our purpose, you may still leave.
The crowd erupts, heated protests and arguments drowning out all else.

items.speaker: School of Mei Believer IV
items.text: My family is long gone, and I wouldn't have made it this far without Master Rén's teachings. I will stand with her and bring the sword back!

items.speaker: School of Mei Believer V
items.text: I traveled all the way from Liaodong, and I'd have died last month if not for Master Rén's help. I'll do whatever I can to return the sword!

items.speaker: School of Mei Believer IV
items.text: Either we die tonight, or we live forever! I stand with Master Rén!

items.speaker: Yam
items.text: It seems this is the only path left for us.

items.speaker: Butterfly
items.text: Everyone else agrees.
Mayfly and Butterfly exchange a meaningful glance. Lost amid the fervent crowd, they join their growing cries, hesitant and then wholeheartedly.

items.speaker: Butterfly
items.text: Then, I, too, will stand with Master Rén!

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: I-I stand with Master Rén!

items.speaker: All Yao
items.text: We all stand with Master Rén!
Oaths and shouts of support spread like waves in a stone-lined pond, pouring back over themselves until the once tranquil courtyard is a cacophony of sound.
Then their master raises her hand, signaling the believers to quiet down.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: You have my thanks.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Do not let fear get the better of you. The final hour approaches; the array is ready. I shall do all that is in my power to enact our plan.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: With or without the sword, meet me under the Mei tree at the first double-hour this night. Together, we will seek our ascension to longevity!
A century-old tale can be told in mere sentences.
Chéng Héguāng looks at her in astonishment, fitting the scattered fragments of his investigation into a clear picture at last.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: So then, those dead animals were the Yao who failed in their pursuit of the Method.
Paper Heron nods.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Lǎnzhū will soon awaken. If we don't stop Rén, her actions may throw the balance of life out of order and put all of Huanzhou in danger.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: We need to evacuate the townsfolk as soon as we can. Time's running out.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: But I'm wounded. It will be a while before I can move again.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Will you aid me in this?
His mouth opens in surprise, but the words don't come. After a moment's deliberation, he makes his decision.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: This is no small favor. It'll take the effort of every soldier and constable in town to evacuate the people in time.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Even if I believe you, my superiors won't be so easily convinced.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Then how about this?
She bows her head and draws the Longevity Sword from within her robes, channeling a thread of Qi into it.
The white blade emanates a cold bright light. It seems almost alive for a moment.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Long ago, when His Eminence walked the land, two white horse tails were bestowed upon him as a reward for his service to the Way. Those tails were forged into a pair of jade swords.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: I carry only one of them. A rare Daoist implement passed down to me by my master, from his master before him. It means more to me than my life.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: I swear on it. I have told you nothing but the truth.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Were you to present this sword to your people, might they ...?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: It'll do.
He fixes his sharp gaze over the Mei pattern and the Bagua array.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: The high lords of this town have close ties with the School of Mei.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: They will recognize this sword.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Then take it. Look after it well.
She sheathes the sword and offers it to him.
He receives it with both hands, feeling the blade's weight.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: You-You're leaving the sword to me, just like that?
She lowers her eyes, managing a weak smile.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: This sword means more to me than my life, yes. But I once valued it so greatly that I lost sight of what is truly important. In the end, it's only a sword.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: And what purpose does a sword have if it is not used to protect?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Well said!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: You have my word. I will protect it with my life.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Should anything go wrong, I will bring my head to you.
In the deep darkness of the night, Paper Heron cannot see the young man's face, but his resolute tone paints a picture the light could not.
She lifts herself just enough to reach his shoulder.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Now, what would I do with a young man's head, eh? Worry not. I'm a Qi reader. I can trace the sword wherever it goes.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Now go. Rén won't give up the sword easily, so be careful. I'll find you once I'm back on my feet.
Distant screams and wails drift through the air. Across the county, fires burst and flicker against the night sky.
Yao shadows slide across the wall. Any doubt that Paper Heron speaks the truth vanishes from him.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: What if ...

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Just go!
Chéng Héguāng grits his teeth, takes the Longevity Sword to his side, and leaps onto the high wall.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Chéng! I owe you for this.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: For setting aside grudges and helping me. I know the School of Mei burned down your home. If we survive this, I'll help you build a new one.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: The School of Mei?
At these words, the young man atop the wall turns around, his usually stern face broken into a rare, wild-eyed smile.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: To tell you the truth ...

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I set that fire myself.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Wait, what?
Her eyes widen in surprise, but the tiles stand empty before she can respond.
Before her, Yao surge from the shadows in their true forms, eyes gleaming green beneath the moon.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Well now, never judge a book by its cover, eh?

items.speaker: School of Mei Believer IV
items.text: Heron! Return the sword at once!

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: And if I refuse?

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Come, let me see how Rén trains her students!
Yamen, Ancient Zhu County
The Yamen is silent. The bell beneath the roof's beastly guardians has not moved.
Chéng Héguāng crosses over the gate. In a few strides, he reaches the still-lit study and extends his hand toward the door.
Commander Lì ...
The unfamiliar voice stops him in place.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: There's someone else inside?
After a moment's consideration, he crouches and places his ear up to the door.
Haha! It truly was a masterstroke.
Had it not been for your arrests, the Yao wouldn't have turned to me so quickly, or in such numbers.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: As an otter drives fish into the lakes and the eagle leads birds into the woods, heh heh, the hunter must know where his prey will run.
You have honored your word. I will keep your efforts in mind when I next speak to your superiors.
I have one more favor to ask.
The conversation grows indistinct as fury clouds Chéng Héguāng's focus.
Clarity returns. But only after he finds himself standing resolutely behind a door that has been kicked wide open.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Lì Huìfēng!
